top_choice_rationale: P002 rewards the clearest clue from nature on the slate: the quantitative Bistritzer-MacDonald prediction of flat bands at a magic angle, then the 2018 discovery of correlated insulating and superconducting states at that angle, widely reproduced across moire systems. The allocation to MacDonald, Jarillo-Herrero and Bistritzer fits the prediction-plus-experiment chain, and the unsettled pairing mechanism is not a reason to wait, as with 1987 and 2013. P001 is a solid second: real, reproduced, but close to the 2016 topology prize with open credit questions (Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang, Hasan). P003 is a strong measurement achievement but more a method and record than a surprise from nature. No award is last since several mature achievements are available.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; David Gross was my PhD supervisor but has no role in any proposal, and I have no tie to any credited laureate
